description.en: Specifies whether the ObjectId parameter specifies a disaster recovery set ID.

description.zh: IsPlanId选择false传入ApplicationId（应用ID），IsPlanId选择true传入PlanId（容灾集ID）
description.en: If you set IsPlanId to false, specify the ID of a disaster recovery application. If you set IsPlanId to true, specify the ID of a disaster recovery set.

title.zh: 获取容灾服务可切换的可用区列表

descriptions.zh: 获取指定容灾服务可切换的可用区列表。
descriptions.en: Queries the zones to which a disaster recovery service can fail over.
